visualCharacteristics: Two-column webshop product page: product image in a white rounded card beside a buy box (brand, h1 title, subtitle, large price, green/red stock dot, primary order button and outline back button, article number, Ziggo Geschikt badge); below a divider the description on the left and a grey striped specifications list on the right. Stacks to one column below 768px.
contentPattern: Two-cell key | value rows, any order, all optional: image, brand, title (h1), subtitle, price, stock ( = not available), sku, order (), back (), description (rich text), specs (heading + list of label value), note (rich text), certified (:ziggo-geschikt: icon + label). Generated by the json2html template templates/randapparatuur/product.html from the products sheet.
usage: Product detail page of the Ziggo randapparatuur webshop, rendered from one row of the products sheet via json2html (BYOM overlay).
reuseGuidance: Use for any single-product page; add product fields as extra key | value rows rather than new blocks, and keep the data in the products sheet instead of authoring it per page.
